svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Column: cut 907 mm of 80 x 60 x 3 mm tube, ends square. In the front and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back walls drill four 22 mm access holes, 30 mm each side of centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 25 and 115 mm below the top. In the left wall drill two 9 mm holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for M6 rivnuts, 477 mm up, 20 and 45 mm back from the front face; in the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: right wall two more, 392 mm up, 19 and 41 mm back (plunger rest).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shelf: 110 x 150 x 20 mm. 46 mm hole centred 65 mm from its back edge;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: four M8 tapped holes on an 82 mm circle at 45 degrees; three M5 holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 10 deep underneath on a 132 mm circle (front, back left, back right).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back plate 110 x 120 x 8 mm. Head plate 120 x 140 x 8 mm with four 11 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes at 30 mm each side, 25 mm from top and bottom, countersunk on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back so the screw heads sit flush against the column.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld: shelf top 479 mm up the column, back edge on the front face; back

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plate on the shelf and the column corners; head plate flush with the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top, holes on the access holes. Fillet welds 5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the shelf is square to the column within 0.5 mm over 100 mm.
